visual.name: lollipopChart
visual.description: Lollipop chart with per-category targets, marker sizing by measure, small multiples and reference lines and bands. Horizontal or vertical, with drill-down, cross-filtering and conditional formatting.

dataRoles.description: Category field or hierarchy that defines one lollipop per member.
dataRoles.name: category

dataRoles.description: Measure that positions the marker along the value axis.
dataRoles.name: value

dataRoles.description: Optional per-category target. Draws a target tick and enables variance banding, target labels and change labels.
dataRoles.name: target

dataRoles.description: Optional measure mapped to the marker radius.
dataRoles.name: markerSize

dataRoles.description: Optional grouping field. Splits the chart into one panel per member.
dataRoles.name: smallMultiples

dataRoles.description: Optional measure that positions the reference line. Overrides the Value set on the Reference Lines card.
dataRoles.name: referenceLine

dataRoles.description: Extra fields appended to the tooltip.
dataRoles.name: tooltips
